benchmark.note: Timing figures are measured on the harness machine and are reported, not constants; only the ordering assertions (512 < 768 < 1024) and the ratio bound are checked.

combiner.comment: Hybrid shared secret = HKDF-SHA256(salt=None, info='pftl-hybrid-handshake-v1', input = x25519_ss || mlkem_ss), 32-byte output. HKDF is RFC 5869; the construction is the harness's own, not a pinned-tree value.

hybrid_wire.comment: Hybrid public key = X25519 public key (32 bytes) concatenated with the ML-KEM encapsulation key; hybrid ciphertext = X25519 public key (32 bytes) concatenated with the ML-KEM ciphertext. Sizes are arithmetic, verified by the harness.

source: NIST FIPS 203 (DOI 10.6028/NIST.FIPS.203, published 13 August 2024), Table 2 (parameter sets) and Table 3 (key/ciphertext sizes); RFC 7748 section 5 (X25519); pinned postfiatd tree src/libxrpl/basics/make_SSLContext.cpp.
